I, Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and LandDevelopment hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct.

An allotment of land in total extent of about 0.6197 Hectare, depictedin Advance Tracing No. Ya/DLF/2014/122 dated 30th July, 2014prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys - Jaffna District,situated in the Village called Delft East in the Grama Niladhari DivisionNo. J/06 of Delft East in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Delft,Jaffna District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Parayantharai – Extent: About 0.6197 HectareNorth: Pararyantharai claimed by Kanapathipillai Kailayapillaiand others; East: Path; South: Pararyantharai claimed by VelupillaiKanagarajah and others; West: Pararyantharai claimed by VelupillaiKanagarajah Kanapathipillai and others.
Janaka Bandara Thennakoon,Minister of Lands and Land Development.
